questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Present Perfect Form: Have/has + past participle: I have finished. | She has lived here for years.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: I ___ never flown.
questions.explanation: Have you ever…? | I have never…

questions.question: Complete: ___ have just sent the email.
questions.explanation: Just = very recent | Already = before expected | Yet = until now (?/−)
